title: Understanding Risk Factors Involved in Developing a Second Blood Clot.
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to develop a way to predict which patients diagnosed with idiopathic blood clots can safely stop warfarin therapy after six months. We will use patient characteristics, blood test results and imaging test results to identify those patients who have the lowest risk of developing a new blood clot after warfarin is stopped.
study_population: patients diagnosed with idiopathic blood clots
